items.title: A sheaf on a colimit of sites is the colimit of its pushforwards and pullbacks
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma expresses a sheaf on the colimit site as the filtered colimit of the pullbacks of its pushforwards along the transition morphisms, with transition maps satisfying a cocycle condition (statement lines 4214-4226). The proof is a complete argument: the canonical maps are defined as counits of the adjunctions (proof lines 4229-4237); the cocycle condition follows from the general composition rule for counits (proof lines 4238-4242); and the identification of the colimit with the sheaf is obtained by evaluating at an object and comparing with the description of the values supplied by the companion result (proof lines 4243-4263). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two colimit descriptions. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
